system.description:
The vampire with this power can animate his own bowels, imbuing them with manipulative and even combat potential. The writhing entrails may be used as crude whips, extra limbs, or snares, though they lack the strength to constrict foes outright.

System: Costs one Blood Trait. Activation is automatic, though the vampire suffers a level of normal damage as his bowels burst free through his abdomen. While active, the vampire gains extra actions each turn for grappling, striking, or similar maneuvers using the animated entrails, though these extra actions cannot add dice to an existing action, only grant additional ones.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
